      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,

      "rationale": "Release notes updates that accompany a functional code change belong to the area being changed rather than docs."
    },
    {
      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes mempool expiry options and the EXPIRY removal reason from kernel headers (src/kernel/mempool_options.h, src/kernel/mempool_removal_reason.h).",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Edits to kernel files are mechanical removals of mempool parameters and removal reasons following the main mempool policy change."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the Mempool label and removes age-based eviction, the EXPIRY removal reason, and the entry_time index from CTxMemPool.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removing time-based expiry permanently eliminates an incentive-incompatible eviction policy that drops mineable transactions and causes bandwidth-consuming rebroadcasts. Fleet monitoring cited in the description showed 92% of expired transactions were eventually mined, while removing the entry_time multi-index container eliminates an ordered-tree node per entry and an O(log n) tree maintenance cost on every insertion and deletion."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Deletes test/functional/mempool_expiry.py and updates fuzz targets and functional tests to accommodate the removal of expiry.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Test modifications solely adapt existing functional tests and fuzz harnesses to the removal of mempool expiry rather than improving testing infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Retains -mempoolexpiry as a hidden, warned no-op during node startup in src/init.cpp and src/node/mempool_args.cpp.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Argument handling changes whose sole purpose is handling a deprecated area-specific option belong to that area rather than utils."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Removes unused validation interface parameters and signals in src/validation.cpp, src/validation.h, and src/validationinterface.h.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "",
      "rationale": "Edits in validation files only clean up the removal reason enum and do not change block or transaction validation logic."
    },
    {
      "name": "wallet",
